concerns.text: Task T013 cites 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/numenta/NAB/master/data/realKnownCause/...' for DEG (Database of Essential Genes) data. This URL points to the Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (time-series data), not the DEG database. There is no task to fetch the actual DEG essentiality labels (FR-002, US-1). Without a valid data source task, the core requirement to download essentiality labels is unimplementable.

Task T009 describes fetching the phylogenetic tree from OpenTree but includes logic to 'skip... gracefully' if the fetch fails. FR-006 and US-2 require PGLS to account for phylogenetic non-independence. If the tree is missing, the comparative analysis (FR-006) cannot be performed as specified. The task lacks a mandatory fallback or a requirement to halt if the tree is unavailable, leaving the FR-006 implementation path ambiguous for the 'missing tree' edge case defined in the spec.

SC-001 requires measuring the proportion of significant correlations against an empirical null distribution generated by shuffling labels '[deferred] times'. Tasks T018a and T018b implement the permutation loop and p-value calculation but do not specify the number of permutations (the '[deferred]' value). Without a concrete number (e.g., 1000) or a task to define this parameter in config, the implementation of SC-001 is incomplete and non-reproducible.

The plan and spec require a 'quickstart.md' for reproducibility (Constitution Principle I, Plan Section 'Project Structure'). Task T034 is marked as 'Documentation updates' but is not linked to a specific requirement ID (e.g., FR-000 or Plan-Quickstart) and is in the 'Polish' phase. Reproducibility is a core constraint, not a polish item. A dedicated task to author the quickstart guide with exact reproduction steps is missing from the critical path.

Task T013 description contains a broken URL placeholder: 'https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-017-02030-0 equivalent public endpoint'. This is not a valid data source. The task description needs to be corrected to point to the actual DEG database download URL or a specific mirror, rather than referencing a paper as a data endpoint.
